s06Trace.owner: Media multimodal / canonical async job submission owner
s06Trace.expectedAsyncInput: exact immutable source version, selected target capability command/version, typed closed input schema, selected profile, purpose, actor authority, rights/consent, resource budget, stable request identity
s06Trace.admissionOutcome: durable owner submit receipt only if authoritative; request intent alone is neither QUEUED nor completed result
s06Trace.unknownOutcome: preserve same stable request identity and reconcile before retry
s06Trace.completion: requires exact later owner source-grounded typed output observation; never synthesize output from receipt
s06Trace.how: Promote the already authored P3 source-only invocation adapter into an exact authoritative *definition join*: action → exact selected capability operation target → versioned job.submit wrapper. Enforce capabilityRef+target operation+version uniqueness, direct request-field adapter/schema closure, output type, rights/actor/policy resource bounds and no-recursive wrapper. Update J06 step + purpose + adapter refs consistently, invoke existing validatePdp3JobSubmitAdapter and resolveJobSubmitParameterSchema; introduce negative fixtures for wrong target/ref/version, stale source, missing policy/guard and duplicate job. Do not modify P1 canonical meaning unless a true P1 contract defect is found. Preserve NO_P1_MACHINE_TRANSITION/UNKNOWN until actual owner receipt/state observation is explicitly defined.
s06Trace.acceptance: Exactly one guarded versioned P3 adapter connects all three operation roles; all typed source/target/goal constraints validate; J06:01 step/owner-purpose source refs reconcile, no invented QUEUED, duplicate submits or runtime admission; focused tests and adversarial cases PASS.

decidedPolicy.incrementalInvalidation: Only real changed normative requirements, operations, consumer contract or owner policy reopens owning PDP and transitive dependencies.
